title: Framework PR #42 CPython 3.14 Pyright rejects two test-fixture annotations
title_de: Framework-PR #42: CPython-3.14-Pyright weist zwei Test-Fixture-Annotationen zurück
profile: Framework PR #42 CPython 3.14 hosted Pyright fixture-typing follow-up
summary: Historical Framework PR #42 head f2f77336e57e9ce6b20af0f8b128c4bb1b062e1c failed Python-quality run 29961019802/job 89061788219 while hosted CPython 3.14.6 ran pinned Pyright. The focused Message[str, str] and dict[str, object] test-fixture correction was already proven on PR head 2930e04e1558b5b10bdeb87a76abb077a2085566. PR #42 was then normally merged, and exact resulting Framework master 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8 has a successful CI security Python quality workflow run 29989195066. The original CI failure is therefore verified, not closed. The separately accepted FND-SONAR-0002 and FND-GITHUB-0007 delivery limitations are retained as separate records and do not reclassify this repaired Pyright defect as blocked.
summary_de: Der historische Head f2f77336e57e9ce6b20af0f8b128c4bb1b062e1c von Framework-PR #42 scheiterte im Python-Quality-Run 29961019802/Job 89061788219, während gehostetes CPython 3.14.6 gepinntes Pyright ausführte. Die fokussierte Message[str, str]- und dict[str, object]-Test-Fixture-Korrektur war bereits auf PR-Head 2930e04e1558b5b10bdeb87a76abb077a2085566 nachgewiesen. PR #42 wurde danach normal gemergt, und der exakte resultierende Framework-Master 935cf14c676a24672be5c336e92cd13457cc35c8 hat den erfolgreichen CI-security-Python-quality-Workflow-Run 29989195066. Der ursprüngliche CI-Fehler ist deshalb verified, nicht closed. Die separat akzeptierten Delivery-Limitierungen FND-SONAR-0002 und FND-GITHUB-0007 bleiben getrennte Records und klassifizieren diesen behobenen Pyright-Defekt nicht als blocked.

impact: The exact affected PR head could not satisfy its required Python-quality gate, so the observation was a P1 release blocker. It remains non-security: severity is not_applicable and security_relevant is false. The resulting-master Python-quality workflow now succeeds, so this repaired defect is no longer a release blocker. The failure does not establish a runtime defect, dependency ABI problem, OSV failure, or a permitted reason to alter Pyright, Ruff, workflow, Quality Gate, or test-control policy.

root_cause: The test fixtures were behaviorally sufficient but incompletely typed for the pinned Pyright standard-library contract used by the hosted CPython 3.14.6 job: HTTPError hdrs is Message[str, str], and Python dictionaries are invariant. The product updater and CI configuration are not the failing boundary.
root_cause_de: Die Test-Fixtures waren verhaltensmäßig ausreichend, aber für den vom gehosteten CPython-3.14.6-Job verwendeten gepinnten Pyright-Standardbibliotheksvertrag unvollständig typisiert: HTTPError hdrs ist Message[str, str], und Python-Dictionaries sind invariant. Der Produkt-Updater und die CI-Konfiguration sind nicht die fehlerhafte Grenze.
proposed_remediation: Keep the correction test-only: construct Message[str, str] for the HTTPError fixture headers and explicitly type the heterogeneous fixture record as dict[str, object]. Review the one-file diff, run focused tests/Ruff checks, and obtain a new exact-head hosted python-ci-security-quality result. Do not alter updater code, Pyright/Ruff configuration, dependencies, workflow permissions, suppressions, Quality Gates, or security controls.
